Order 
This (fourth) (TEMPORARY) bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of temporary bail under Section 439 of CrPC/483 of BNSS, as he is arrested in relating to FIR No..223/2023 dated : not mentioned, registered at P.S. - Annapurna, District - Indore for offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376 and 376(2)(n) of IPC alongwith 5(j)(ii) and 5(l)/6 of the POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 20.06.2023.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that due to death of father of the applicant, being the only son, the presence of the applicant is required to conduct last rituals of his father.
Applicant is ready to furnish cash security of Rs.25,000/- .
Hence, counsel prayed that the applicant be enlarged on temporary bail for a period of 30 days.
3. In view of the aforesaid submissions and documents filed by the applicant, this Court is inclined to allow the present application for a period of fifteen days only.

4. It is directed that the applicant be enlarged on temporary bail for a period of 15 days from the date of his release upon furnishing cash security of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand only) as well as personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:12172 2 MCRC-20683-2025 satisfaction of the Trial Court, for her regular appearance before the Trial Court during trial with a condition that she shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the Kunal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34076493/
1 dates fixed by it during trial.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.

5. It is made clear that after having completed the aforesaid period, the applicant may surrender before the Trial Court, failing which the concerned Trial Court is having liberty to arrest the applicant in accordance with law.
6. On being surrendered after completion of the aforesaid period, the amount of cash security of Rs.25,000/- shall be returned to the applicant.
7. With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
